headline: Brazil’s ANPD consultation analysis maps platform oversight and AI intimate-image proposals
summary: On 15 October 2026, Brazil’s data-protection authority (ANPD) published Technical Note 23/2026 analyzing consultation responses on platform regulation under the Marco Civil da Internet. The note says 74 submissions were received and 66 analyzed after screening; participation was led by private-sector contributors (47%), followed by organized civil society (30.3%). ANPD’s synthesis highlights calls for clearer platform-responsibility criteria, proportionate risk-based supervision, transparency reporting and complaint channels, and preventive safeguards against nonconsensual AI-generated intimate content. It also records disagreement over liability criteria, removal deadlines and the limits of agency authority. This is consultation analysis feeding ongoing regulation, not a final binding rule or a representative poll.
